title: Writing / Duo / Duos and duon'ts
slide_intent: Define a mascot’s permissible behavior so different creators preserve a consistent character.
strategic_value: A paired behavior list can help Duolingo keep Duo’s voice and movement coherent across executions.
demonstration: A checked Duo list sits above a Duon’t list, specifying attribution, pronouns, small gestures and restrictions on speech and movement.
practical_value: Distinguish a character rule from a general brand voice rule when planning a historical Duo execution.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Duos and Duon’ts heading and staying-in-character rationale at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the permitted actions above prohibited behaviors at right, preserving their separate labels.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly connects behavioral consistency with the way people recognize familiar characters.
reference_purposes.Application: The allowed list describes attribution and small gestures.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The archived rules prohibit spoken sounds, unassigned narration, signs or weapons and sudden movement, and identify Duo as a day owl.

ingredient.name: Duo’s historical behavior
ingredient.role: Maintain a consistent character across creators.
ingredient.application: Attribute first-person text explicitly to Duo; use restrained gestures. Preserve the listed speech and movement prohibitions.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. These are historical character rules, not statements about today’s mascot campaigns.
